hypothesis: Minibatch variability contributes to fresh-Adam update damage after reducing finite-step amplitude; averaging seven disjoint training batches may improve the same excluded check batches.
changed_factor: Gradient support grows from one 1024-state batch to all seven non-check batches (7168 states). Existing 1e-7 step-scale results are controls, not rerun.
fixed: Same 8192 rows, each excluded check batch, original weights, frozen preprocessing, physical log loss, Adam reset/settings, lr 1e-7 and 1024-row forward shapes.
selection: Identical default_rng(seed+137) permutation prefix8192; check is next cyclic batch, gradient excludes that entire batch. No optimizer steps are chained.
exposure: Training data only; existing base/preprocessing history; no U/D or confirmation. More gradient rows/work are the declared factor.
prechecks: Original decoder/gradient/restoration checks; exact selected-ID parity with control; independent fit/check disjointness and physical recount
work: 16 fresh Adam steps total; each uses 7x1024 rows and six group gradients. One GPU/CPU thread, no candidate export, finite fixed work.

outcomes.check_repair_and_preservation_improve: Register a bounded large-batch low-step continued-base fit and matched-work control, full protected U/D gates
outcomes.fit_only_or_mixed: Close step-noise explanation provisionally; do not launch another batch/LR sweep
outcomes.roundtrip_or_gradient_failure: Stop numerical interpretation and preserve reproducer
